subject: Interim Superintendent Suzanne Galusi
overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed Interim Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Buckley-Galusi regarding her background, district priorities, curriculum updates, and plans for community engagement.

items.title: Superintendent Career Background
items.summary: Interim Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Buckley-Galusi discussed her 28-year career in the Medford Public Schools as a student, teacher, principal, and central office administrator.

items.title: Favorite Medford Eateries
items.summary: Buckley-Galusi shared her favorite local food spots, recommending Magnificent Muffin and Bob's.

items.title: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
items.summary: Buckley-Galusi discussed the wide socioeconomic spectrum in Medford schools and her commitment to culturally responsive leadership and creating safe learning environments.

items.title: Curriculum Shifts and Professional Development
items.summary: Buckley-Galusi outlined updates to the elementary reading curriculum and secondary school instructional support funded by the Barr Foundation.

items.title: Social-Emotional Learning and Student Support
items.summary: Buckley-Galusi highlighted the district's post-pandemic student support initiatives, such as the Nexus program, and noted positive survey feedback regarding student safety.

items.title: District Report Card and State Accountability
items.summary: Buckley-Galusi explained how the district's accountability ratings remain tied to MCAS testing despite state ballot changes to graduation requirements.

items.title: Community Outreach and Meet-and-Greets
items.summary: Buckley-Galusi announced a series of upcoming meet-and-greets with staff, caregivers, and special advisory groups to gather community feedback.
